paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “Prompt Length” and has a linear scale ranging from 2 to 16, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 76 to 81, with tick labels at integer values. The first line, representing “mmsd,” is orange with circular markers and a solid style; it begins at approximately 80.5 when the prompt length is 2, decreases to a value of 80.2 at a prompt length of 4, and then rises to approximately 80.7 at a prompt length of 16. The second line, representing “mmsd2,” is yellow with circular markers and a solid style; it begins at approximately 77.3 when the prompt length is 2, decreases to a value of 76.5 at a prompt length of 4, rises to approximately 77.4 at a prompt length of 8, and then declines to a value of 76.2 at a prompt length of 16.
